facts.text: Danny, the freezer's stocked with enough for the whole winter. Help yourself to the ice cream, it's the good stuff.
facts.why: Hallorann never says this. On the kitchen tour he shows Wendy and Danny the walk-in freezer and says 'You folks could eat here for a year and never have the same menu twice.' He then asks Wendy if he can give Danny ice cream and Danny picks chocolate. The line on the menu is invented.
facts.fix: You folks could eat here for a year and never have the same menu twice.
